display_long_description:
Protect your lunch in Fly Smasher VR — an arcade VR survival game where giant flies are always one buzz away from stealing your food. 🍔🪰

You’ve got two massive swatters, fast reflexes, and one job: don’t let them feast!

# Smash the swarm 🖐️

Waves of flies come from every angle. Swing, slap, and swat like your meal depends on it (because it does).

[media]

# Survive special flies (and worse) ⚠️

It’s not just basic pests — expect tricky variants that force you to adapt… and fly-bosses that show up to ruin your day.

[media]

# Upgrade your gear 🔧

Earn rewards, power up your swatters, and unlock upgrades that make you faster, stronger, and harder to steal from.

[media]

# Chase the high score 🏆

The longer you survive, the crazier it gets. Set a new best run, then try to beat it again. Fast hands. Big swats. Zero mercy.

How long can you keep your food safe?

[media]
